info.title: Payer Gateway Web API
info.description: Da Vinci prior authorization for the EHR. Call order: 1) POST /api/v1/crd/order-sign  2) DTR forms (when documentation is needed)  3) POST /api/v1/pas/requests (when prior auth is needed)  4) CDex attachments (when the payer pends and asks for more). Every EHR request carries payerName; the gateway finds that payer in table PA_PAYER. All gateway data is stored in the EHR database through the EHR data API, so decisions are not written back separately. No authentication is built in (it is added outside this code). Errors always return { "error": "...", "details": [ ... ], "traceId": "..." }.

get.summary: Documents / forms the payer asked for on a pended request.
get.description:
Each information request lists LOINC document types (documentsNeeded) and / or questionnaires (questionnairesNeeded).
For questionnaires: POST /api/v1/dtr/forms with those URLs, answer them, then send the questionnaireResponseId.

parameters.name: refresh
parameters.description: true = search the payer's Tasks now instead of waiting for the background job.

post.summary: Sends additional documents and / or completed forms to the payer ($submit-attachment).
post.description:
Use for a pended request (the first documents go with PAS). With final = true the gateway asks the payer for the
new decision right away and returns it in "decision".

requestBody.description: Required. Documents, forms and the tracking id. Send at least one documentId or questionnaireResponseId.

400.description: Nothing to send, or unknown tracking id.

422.description: No member id, or the payer rejected the attachments (body = result with messages).

502.description: The payer or the FHIR API failed, or the file of a document could not be read.

504.description: The payer did not answer in time.

post.summary: Called BY THE PAYER to push a Task (or a Bundle of Tasks) asking for more information.

requestBody.description: A FHIR Task or a Bundle of Tasks.

400.description: Not a Task or a Bundle of Tasks, or the Task is not valid FHIR.

422.description: The Task is not about a request sent by this gateway.

post.summary: Order signed: asks the payer (CDS Hooks order-sign) and returns one coverage decision per order.
post.description:
The gateway reads the patient, orders and coverage from the FHIR API, calls the payer named in
payerName, and reads pa-needed / doc-needed from the payer's answer.
            
What to do with each decision:
- **callDtr = true** → POST /api/v1/dtr/forms with questionnaireUrls and coverageAssertionId, then send the answers.
- **callPas = true** → POST /api/v1/pas/requests (after DTR when both are true).
- both false → nothing more is needed for that order.
            
If the payer cannot be reached (or its answer cannot be read), the call still returns 200 with covered = "unknown" and payerCall.outcome = "timeout" / "error".
Orders are service orders and medication orders (FHIR ServiceRequest / MedicationRequest).
Sending the same eventId again returns the stored answer without calling the payer.

requestBody.description: Required. The signing event: eventId, payerName, patientId and orderIds must be filled.

200.description: One decision per order (see callDtr / callPas).

400.description: Invalid body, missing field, unknown payerName, an order of another patient, or no signing clinician (userPractitionerId is empty and the orders have no ordering practitioner).

404.description: Patient or orders not found at the FHIR API.

422.description: The patient has several active insurances and neither coverageId nor the orders say which one to use.

get.summary: Latest coverage decision of an order (no payer call).

404.description: No order-sign was run for this order.

tags: DTR 1 - Forms (our questionnaire app or EHR screen)
post.summary: Gets the payer's questionnaire(s) for the orders, as simple questions.
post.description:
Call when order-sign returned callDtr = true. The gateway calls the payer's Questionnaire/$questionnaire-package
with the orders and coverage, and returns one form per questionnaire.
            
Next: show each question (text, type, options, required, showWhen) on the EHR screen and send the answers to
POST /api/v1/dtr/forms/{formId}/answers. During testing the answers can be sent from Swagger or Postman.

requestBody.description: Required. Payer, patient, orders and the questionnaire URLs from the order-sign decision.

400.description: Invalid body, missing field, unknown payerName, or an order of another patient.

404.description: An order was not found at the FHIR API.

422.description: No active insurance (or several and none chosen: send coverageId), or the payer refused / returned no questionnaire.

502.description: The payer or the FHIR API failed.

504.description: The payer did not answer in time.

tags: DTR 1 - Forms (our questionnaire app or EHR screen)
get.summary: Reads a form: its questions and the answers saved so far.

parameters.name: formId
parameters.description: Form id from POST /api/v1/dtr/forms, e.g. frm-6f1c2a9e.

tags: DTR 1 - Forms (our questionnaire app or EHR screen)
post.summary: Saves the answers of a form (builds and stores the FHIR QuestionnaireResponse).
post.description:
Send one entry per question: { "linkId": "...", "values": ["..."] }. Values are text in the format of the question type
(boolean "true", integer "12", date "2026-08-10", choice = the option code, quantity "12 mL/min").
            
- Answers are merged with earlier ones; an entry with an empty values list removes that answer.
- complete = true: all required (shown) questions must be answered, otherwise 422 lists them.
- complete = false: saved as in-progress; missingRequired lists what is still open.
            
The QuestionnaireResponse is saved at the FHIR API. POST /api/v1/pas/requests attaches completed forms
of the same orders automatically; for CDex send questionnaireResponseId in the attachments call.

requestBody.description: Required. The answers (one entry per answered question).

200.description: Saved; the QuestionnaireResponse id is returned.

400.description: An answer has the wrong format or is not one of the options (details list each one). Nothing saved.

422.description: complete = true but required questions are unanswered (details list them). Nothing saved.

502.description: The FHIR API failed to save the form.

tags: DTR 1 - Forms (our questionnaire app or EHR screen)
get.summary: Lists the DTR forms saved for a patient (by the gateway forms or by a payer's SMART DTR app).
get.description:
After the payer's own DTR app was used (it saves its QuestionnaireResponse at the FHIR API), call this to see
whether the form is completed. POST /api/v1/pas/requests attaches completed forms of the same orders automatically.

parameters.name: orderId
parameters.description: Optional: only the forms of this order.

200.description: The saved forms, newest first (empty list when none).

get.summary: Opens a payer's SMART DTR app (link from an order-sign message, type "smart").
get.description:
Opened in the clinician's browser. Creates the SMART launch at the FHIR API - with the
payer's FHIR release (R4 / R5) - and redirects (302) to the
payer's DTR app with iss and launch. Shows a short HTML page when the link is invalid or expired.

parameters.name: linkId
parameters.description: Id at the end of the link.

302.description: Redirect to the payer DTR app.

post.summary: For payer SMART DTR apps: $questionnaire-package passed to the payer unchanged (body = FHIR Parameters).
post.description: Only needed when a DTR app calls the payer through the gateway (most payer apps call their own payer directly).

requestBody.description: Required. FHIR Parameters from the DTR app.

200.description: The payer's FHIR answer (the payer's own status code is passed through).

502.description: The payer could not be reached.

504.description: The payer did not answer in time.

post.summary: For payer SMART DTR apps: adaptive forms, $next-question passed to the payer unchanged.

requestBody.description: Required. FHIR Parameters / QuestionnaireResponse from the DTR app.

200.description: The payer's FHIR answer (the payer's own status code is passed through).

502.description: The payer could not be reached.

504.description: The payer did not answer in time.

post.summary: Submits a new prior authorization request (Claim/$submit).
post.description:
Call when order-sign returned callPas = true (after DTR when callDtr was also true).
The gateway builds the PAS Bundle with the Claim, patient, coverage, organization, practitioner and orders,
attaches **completed DTR forms of these orders automatically**, plus the documents in documentIds (file embedded).
            
overallStatus in the answer: approved | partially-approved | denied | pended | not-required | contact-payer.
When pended, the payer may ask for more (informationRequests) → CDex attachments.
Nothing is saved when the payer rejects the request (422 / 502 with the payer's errors); correct the data and
send the same requestId again. The payer can reject with an HTTP error or with an answer that only carries errors
(for example "member not found") - both give 422.

requestBody.description: Required. The prior authorization request: requestId, payerName, patientId, requestingOrganizationId and orderIds must be filled.

201.description: Accepted by the payer; the decision (may be pended).

400.description: Invalid body, missing field, unknown payerName, or an order of another patient.

404.description: Patient, order, organization, form or document not found at the FHIR API.

409.description: requestId was already submitted (use PUT to change it).

422.description: No active insurance (or several and none chosen: send coverageId), insurance without member id, order without code, organization without NPI, or the payer rejected the request (body = decision with errors).

502.description: The payer or the FHIR API failed, the payer's answer could not be read, or the file of a document could not be read.

504.description: The payer did not answer in time.

put.summary: Changes a request: add / remove orders, add forms or documents (Claim update).
put.description: Send the full list of orders that should stay in the request; orders left out are sent as cancelled lines.

requestBody.description: Required. The changed request (requestId in the body may be empty or must match the URL).

400.description: Invalid body, ids do not match, or patient / payer changed.

404.description: Unknown requestId, or data not found at the FHIR API.

422.description: Insurance without member id, order without code, organization without NPI, or the payer rejected the update (body = decision with errors). The stored request is unchanged.

502.description: The payer or the FHIR API failed, the payer's answer could not be read, or the file of a document could not be read.

504.description: The payer did not answer in time.

post.summary: Cancels the whole request (every line sent to the payer as cancelled).

requestBody.description: Optional. The reason for cancelling; the body may be left out.

422.description: The request's data can no longer be read, or the payer rejected the cancel (the request stays as it was).

502.description: The payer or the FHIR API failed.

504.description: The payer did not answer in time.

post.summary: Asks the payer for the latest decision now (Claim/$inquire).
post.description: The background job also does this every Workflow:PollMinutes for pended requests.

200.description: The latest decision (the stored one when the payer has nothing new, or the request is cancelled).

502.description: The payer failed or answered the inquiry with errors only. The stored decision is unchanged.

504.description: The payer did not answer in time.

post.summary: Called BY THE PAYER (PAS Subscription rest-hook) when a decision changes.
post.description: The gateway then inquires every open request of that payer and saves the new decisions.

parameters.name: payerName
parameters.description: Payer name (part of the Subscription endpoint the gateway registered).

400.description: The body is not a valid FHIR Bundle.

get.summary: Lists the configured payers (table PA_PAYER in the EHR database; appsettings "Payers" in memory mode).
get.description: Use a payerName from this list in every other request.

503.description: The EHR data API is not available.

post.summary: Tests a payer connection: GET {payer}/cds-services (CDS Hooks discovery).
post.description:
Shows which hooks the payer supports (look for "order-sign") and its prefetch templates,
and refreshes the gateway's 12-hour cache. Use it when a new payer is onboarded.

parameters.name: payerName
parameters.description: Payer name from GET /api/v1/payers, e.g. MockPayer.

502.description: The payer answered with an error.

504.description: The payer did not answer in time.

error.description: What went wrong, in one sentence.
error.example: Payer 'UnknownPayer' is not configured. Configured payers: MockPayer.

details.description: Extra messages (validation problems, payer OperationOutcome issues, missing required questions).

traceId.description: Id of this request in the gateway log (give it to support).

ApiError.description: Error body returned by every endpoint for 400 / 404 / 409 / 422 / 500 / 502 / 503 / 504.

trackingId.description: Tracking id of the payer's information request. Empty = the latest open one, or unsolicited.

documentIds.description: EHR document ids (DocumentReference ids at the FHIR API).

lineNumbers.description: Claim line numbers the attachments support. Empty = the whole request.

final.description: true (default) = nothing more will be sent; the payer re-reviews now.

AttachmentSubmitRequest.description:
Body of POST /api/v1/cdex/requests/{requestId}/attachments: additional documents and DTR forms for a pended
prior auth (CDex $submit-attachment), usually to answer a payer information request.

reason.description: Why the request is cancelled (sent to the payer as a note).

CdsDiscoveryResponse.description: Response of GET {payer}/cds-services: the CDS services (one per hook) the payer offers.

CdsServiceDefinition.description: One CDS service: which hook it handles, its id (used in the URL) and its prefetch templates.

covered.description: covered | not-covered | conditional | unknown (unknown = the payer could not be asked).

callDtr.description: true = fill in the payer's questionnaire (DTR) before submitting.

callPas.description: true = submit a prior authorization request (PAS).

informationNeeded.description: performer | location | timeframe | contract-window (information the payer needs to decide).

questionnaireUrls.description: Payer questionnaires to fill in (pass them to POST /api/v1/dtr/forms).

coverageAssertionId.description: Payer id of this CRD answer. Pass it to DTR as coverageAssertionId.

satisfiedAuthorizationNumber.description: Existing authorization that already covers the order (priorAuthNeeded = satisfied).

messages.description: Payer cards and reasons. A SMART (DTR app) link appears here when the payer offers one.

CoverageDecision.description:
CRD answer for one order. Also saved in table PA_COVERAGE_DECISION of the EHR database (column DECISION_JSON),
where the EHR reads it.
What to do next:
  callDtr = true  -> DTR: POST /api/v1/dtr/forms with questionnaireUrls, then POST .../answers
  callPas = true  -> PAS: POST /api/v1/pas/requests (after DTR when both are true)
  both false      -> nothing more for this order (see covered / priorAuthNeeded)

lineNumber.description: Claim line it is for, if the payer said.

DocumentNeeded.description: A document type the payer needs, as a LOINC code.

values.description: The answer(s). Normally one value; several only when the question has repeats = true.

DtrAnswerInput.description:
The answer to one question, as text. Write values like this (the question "type" in GET /api/v1/dtr/forms/{formId}):
  boolean: "true" / "false"          integer: "12"            decimal: "12.5"
  date: "2026-08-10"                 dateTime: "2026-08-10T09:30:00Z"   time: "09:30:00"
  string / text / url: any text      choice / open-choice: the option code (open-choice also free text)
  quantity: "12 mL/min" (number, space, unit)

answers.description: One entry per answered question. Questions not listed stay unanswered.

complete.description:
true = the form is finished (status "completed"): every required question must be answered, otherwise 422.
false = save as "in-progress" and finish later.

DtrAnswersRequest.description:
Body of POST /api/v1/dtr/forms/{formId}/answers: the provider's answers in plain JSON.
The gateway builds the FHIR QuestionnaireResponse (same tree as the payer's Questionnaire) and saves it at the
FHIR API, where PAS picks it up. Can be sent several times; the latest answers replace the earlier ones.

questionnaireResponseId.description: Id of the QuestionnaireResponse saved at the FHIR API. PAS attaches it automatically.

missingRequired.description: Required questions still unanswered (only shown when saving as in-progress).

newQuestions.description: Adaptive only: questions the payer added after these answers. Read the form again and answer them.

moreQuestionsExpected.description: Adaptive only: true while the payer may still add questions.

warnings.description: Answers that were ignored (unknown linkId, display-only question, unsupported type).

questionLinkId.description: linkId of the question to look at.

DtrCondition.description: "Show this question when question X operator value" (from the Questionnaire enableWhen).

formId.description: Gateway id of this form. Use it to read the form and to send the answers.

questionnaireUrl.description: Canonical URL of the payer Questionnaire.

questionnaireResponseId.description: Id of the saved QuestionnaireResponse at the FHIR API (after answers were sent).

adaptive.description: true = adaptive questionnaire: the payer sends new questions after each set of answers.

moreQuestionsExpected.description: Adaptive only: true while the payer may still add questions (send the answers to get them).

questions.description: The questions in display order (groups are flattened; groupText tells which section a question is in).

DtrForm.description:
One payer questionnaire as simple questions (no FHIR needed to show it).
Show the questions, then send the answers to POST /api/v1/dtr/forms/{formId}/answers.

payerName.description: Payer to ask, as configured in table PA_PAYER (PAYER_NAME).

coverageId.description: Insurance to use. Empty = the order's insurance, else the patient's only active insurance. Required when the patient has several active insurances and the order names none.

questionnaireUrls.description: Questionnaire URLs from the order-sign decision (questionnaireUrls). Empty = the payer decides from the orders.

coverageAssertionId.description: coverageAssertionId from the order-sign decision (DTR "context"), or a CDex tracking id.

DtrFormRequest.description:
Body of POST /api/v1/dtr/forms: get the payer's questionnaire(s) for these orders as simple questions.
Use it when the order-sign decision has callDtr = true (or a CDex information request lists questionnaires).

code.description: Send this value as the answer.

system.description: Code system of the option (null for plain text options).

DtrOption.description: One allowed answer of a choice question.

linkId.description: Send this back as linkId with the answer.

type.description:
boolean | decimal | integer | date | dateTime | time | string | text | url | choice | open-choice | quantity |
display (text only, no answer) | attachment | reference (not supported by the gateway; answer via the payer's process).

readOnly.description: true = show only; the payer fills it.

maxLength.description: Maximum text length, when the payer set one.

groupLinkId.description: linkId of the group (section) this question belongs to, or null.

groupText.description: Title of the group (section), or null.

options.description: Allowed answers for choice / open-choice questions. Send the option's code.

optionsValueSet.description: Name of the payer ValueSet with the allowed answers, when the options are not listed.

defaultValues.description: Default answers set by the payer (already filled in if you send nothing else).

currentValues.description: Answers saved so far for this form.

showWhen.description: Show (and answer) this question only when these conditions match. Empty = always shown.

showWhenBehavior.description: all | any: how several showWhen conditions combine.

DtrQuestion.description: One question of a payer form, in plain JSON.

summary.example: Prior authorization required; clinical documentation needed

detail.description: Longer text of the message, when the payer gave one.

EhrMessage.description: A message for the clinician, built from a payer card or a coverage-information reason.

label.description: Text to show for the link.

url.description: Where the link goes. For a DTR launch this is a gateway URL: /api/v1/dtr/launch/{linkId}.

opensPayerApp.description:
type "smart" only. true = the payer works with its own SMART DTR app (PA_PAYER.DTR_MODE = SmartApp): open Url in
a browser window and the payer's app starts. false = the payer's questionnaire is filled in through the gateway
forms (POST /api/v1/dtr/forms); Url still opens the app when the payer's card names one.

EhrMessageLink.description:
A link on a message. type "smart" = a payer DTR app: a plain gateway URL (/api/v1/dtr/launch/{linkId}) the EHR
opens in a browser; the gateway then starts the SMART app. type "absolute" = a normal web page.

trackingId.description: Payer tracking id. Send it back with the attachments.

questionnairesNeeded.description: Payer questionnaires to complete: POST /api/v1/dtr/forms with these URLs, answer, then send the form here.

InformationRequest.description: One payer request for more information (a CDex / PAS Task).

NotificationResult.description: Response to a payer callback (PAS notification or pushed CDex Task).

eventId.description: Unique id of this signing event in the EHR. Sending the same id again returns the stored answer (no second payer call).

payerName.description: Payer to ask, exactly as configured in table PA_PAYER (PAYER_NAME, case does not matter).

orderIds.description: EHR order ids being signed: service orders and medication orders (ServiceRequest or MedicationRequest ids at the FHIR API).

coverageId.description: Insurance to use. Empty = the order's insurance, else the patient's only active insurance. Required when the patient has several active insurances and the order names none.

encounterId.description: Current encounter, if any (CDS Hooks encounterId).

userPractitionerId.description: Clinician signing the order (CDS Hooks userId, required by the payer). Empty = the order's ordering practitioner; when the order has none either, the request is refused (400).

OrderSignRequest.description:
Body of POST /api/v1/crd/order-sign. Sent by the EHR when the clinician signs one or more orders.
The gateway sends the CDS Hooks "order-sign" call to the payer named in payerName.

decisions.description: One decision per order. Read callDtr / callPas to know what to do next.

messages.description: Messages not tied to one order (order not found, general payer cards).

OrderSignResponse.description: Response of POST /api/v1/crd/order-sign: one coverage decision per signed order.

serviceId.description: The payer's CDS service id used for order-sign.

error.description: Why the payer could not be asked, or what went wrong. Empty when outcome is "ok".

PayerCallSummary.description: How the payer call went (shown in the order-sign response for troubleshooting).

payerName.description: The value the EHR sends as payerName.

fhirVersion.description: FHIR release the payer works in: R4 or R5.

dtrMode.description:
Forms = the EHR shows the questionnaire (POST /api/v1/dtr/forms); SmartApp = open the link of the CRD message,
which starts the payer's own SMART DTR app.

PayerSummary.description: A configured payer, as shown by GET /api/v1/payers.

overallStatus.description: approved | partially-approved | denied | pended | not-required | cancelled | contact-payer | error

authorizationNumber.description: Payer's authorization number (put it on the claim later). Also the CDex tracking reference.

decidedAt.description: When the gateway first received this decision from the payer (UTC). Empty while the request is pended.

decisionDueBy.description: When the payer must decide at the latest (CMS-0057-F: 72 hours urgent, 7 days standard).

lines.description: One decision per order / claim line.

informationRequests.description: Documents / forms the payer asked for (CDex). Answer with POST /api/v1/cdex/requests/{id}/attachments.

errors.description: Errors returned by the payer (technical rejection).

PriorAuthDecision.description:
The payer's prior authorization decision in plain JSON. Returned by every PAS endpoint and saved in table
PA_PRIOR_AUTH of the EHR database (column DECISION_JSON), where the EHR reads it.

sequence.description: Claim.item.sequence. Stays the same for an order across updates.

decision.description: approved | partially-approved | denied | pended | not-required | cancelled | contact-payer | modified

x12ActionCode.description: X12 306 code from the payer: A1, A2, A3, A4, A6, C, CT, NA.

requestedQuantity.description: Units asked for on this line.

approvedQuantity.description: Units the payer approved, when it said so.

reason.description: The payer's reason or note for this line.

validFrom.description: First day the line is authorized (yyyy-MM-dd).

validTo.description: Last day the line is authorized (yyyy-MM-dd).

PriorAuthLine.description: Decision for one claim line (one order).

requestId.description: Required for POST. EHR id of the request; becomes Claim.identifier and is used for update, cancel, inquire and CDex. May be empty on PUT (taken from the URL).

payerName.description: Payer to send the request to, as configured in table PA_PAYER (PAYER_NAME).

coverageId.description: Insurance to use. Empty = the orders' insurance, else the patient's only active insurance. Required when the patient has several active insurances and the orders name none.

requestingOrganizationId.description: Provider organization asking for the authorization (must have an NPI).

requestingPractitionerId.description: Requesting clinician. Empty = the first order's ordering practitioner.

orderIds.description: Orders to authorize - one claim line each.

priority.description: routine | urgent (urgent = expedited review, 72 hours under CMS-0057-F).

requestType.description: new (default) | renewal. Renewal lines are sent with X12 certification type R and need previousAuthorizationNumber.

previousAuthorizationNumber.description: Authorization number being renewed (sent as Claim.related, relationship "prior").

previousServiceStart.description: First date of service of the previous authorization (yyyy-MM-dd).

previousServiceEnd.description: Last date of service of the previous authorization (yyyy-MM-dd).

previousTreatments.description: Number of treatments given under the previous authorization.

patientType.description: permanent (default) | transient (patient visiting the facility, e.g. while traveling).

referringPractitionerId.description: Physician who referred the patient (sent as a second care team member).

questionnaireResponseIds.description: Extra DTR forms to attach. Completed forms saved for these orders are attached automatically.

documentIds.description: EHR documents (DocumentReference ids) to attach now; the file content is embedded.

notes.description: Free-text note for the reviewer (max 264 characters are sent).

PriorAuthRequest.description:
Body of POST /api/v1/pas/requests (submit) and PUT /api/v1/pas/requests/{requestId} (update).
The gateway turns it into a PAS request Bundle and calls the payer's Claim/$submit.
Completed DTR forms for these orders are attached automatically.

questionnaire.description: Canonical URL of the payer's questionnaire.

status.description: in-progress | completed | amended | stopped | entered-in-error. Only completed / amended go to PAS automatically.

authored.description: When the form was last saved.

orderId.description: The order the form belongs to (qr-context), when the form names one.

SavedForm.description:
A DTR form (QuestionnaireResponse) saved at the FHIR API - by the gateway forms (our questionnaire app) or by a
payer's SMART DTR app. Returned by GET /api/v1/dtr/saved-forms.
